main.description: One of the caller's own background jobs, such as the one a change to an instance started. Customers only.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a HappyProto customer.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such job, or the caller did not create it. The two are indistinguishable.

job.description: A background job. Never carries its session fields.

progress.description: The job's last progress report. For an instance change: {status, step?}, the operation's.

result.description: What the job returned, once completed.

error.description: Why the job failed. For an instance change, the operation's error code, then its message.
